risk_description: Warm and humid conditions accelerate lesion spread with concentric rings.
treatment_protocol: Apply protectant fungicide (mancozeb or chlorothalonil). Remove lower infected leaves. Maintain dry canopy.
organic_remedies: Copper octanoate spray; neem oil; dilute potassium bicarbonate (3g/L).
prevention: Rotate solanaceous crops every 2-3 seasons; use drip irrigation; stake and prune indeterminate vines.

risk_description: Cool moist nights and wet foliage create rapid epidemic contagion.
treatment_protocol: Act immediately — late blight spreads rapidly. Apply systemic fungicide (mefenoxam or cymoxanil) within 24 hours.
organic_remedies: Preventative fixed copper spray (Bordeaux mixture); Bacillus subtilis biofungicide.
prevention: Destroy infected cull piles; plant resistant cultivars (e.g. Mountain Magic); avoid night-time overhead watering.

risk_description: Canopy is vigorous with normal photosynthetic activity and no active pathogen.
treatment_protocol: No treatment required. Maintain balanced N-P-K fertilization and weekly inspection.
organic_remedies: Compost mulch to preserve soil microbiome; companion planting with marigold and basil.
prevention: Routine surveillance every 3-5 days; sanitize pruning shears between plants.

risk_description: Warm days and heavy dew favor leaf spot expansion and premature senescence.
treatment_protocol: Apply protectant fungicide (chlorothalonil or azoxystrobin). Ensure adequate nitrogen nutrition.
organic_remedies: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens microbial inoculant; copper hydroxide formulation.
prevention: Avoid planting adjacent to older solanaceous fields; hill soil properly to protect tubers from spores.

risk_description: Foliage shows vibrant green tissue with intact cuticle and optimal transpiration.
treatment_protocol: No intervention needed. Continue regular irrigation scheduling and soil scouting.
organic_remedies: Organic fish emulsion foliar feed; straw mulching for moisture retention.
prevention: Inspect field margins weekly for early aphid vectors and localized leaf spot spots.

risk_description: Warm temperatures and rainfall create splashing bacterial inoculum across plants.
treatment_protocol: Spray fixed copper bactericide combined with mancozeb. Avoid handling wet plants.
organic_remedies: Copper octanoate; liquid garlic extract spray; Streptomyces lydicus bio-bactericide.
prevention: Use hot-water treated or certified disease-free seed; drip irrigate; remove volunteers immediately.

risk_description: Stems and leaves exhibit normal turgor with clear lamina and healthy chloroplastic activity.
treatment_protocol: No treatment required. Maintain consistent soil moisture to prevent blossom end rot.
organic_remedies: Neem cake soil amendment; vermicompost top dressing.
prevention: Scout weekly for thrips and mites; ensure adequate calcium and magnesium availability.

risk_description: Moderate temperatures and high humidity accelerate urediniospore germination on leaf surfaces.
treatment_protocol: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides at first sign of pustules on upper canopy leaves.
organic_remedies: Sulfur dust; bio-fungicides containing Bacillus pumilus; potassium silicate foliar wash.
prevention: Plant resistant corn hybrids; early planting to avoid late-season airborne spore showers.

risk_description: Vigorous vegetative growth with strong stalk structural integrity and clean green foliage.
treatment_protocol: No fungicide needed. Maintain side-dress nitrogen schedule and weed-free field rows.
organic_remedies: Seaweed foliar tonic; mycorrhizal root inoculant.
prevention: Ensure proper plant density and airflow; monitor whorls periodically for pest damage.
